name: Ethical Dilemmas
excerpt: Ethical dilemmas involve choosing between right actions and self-interest.
notes: Ethical dilemmas occur when there is a conflict between doing the 'right thing' and acting in one's own self-interest. These choices often affect stakeholders differently, helping one group while potentially harming another.
context_summary:
- Involves conflict between right actions and self-interest.
- Affects stakeholders differently.
- Can help one group while harming another.
